Support should continue using the existing order timeline to see the outcome.'

Here's the incident that prompted the extra requirement:

```
14:02:11 worker-3 received message msg_412 for ord_927
14:02:12 worker-3 mailer accepted delivery mail_881
14:02:12 worker-3 connection lost before queue acknowledgement
14:03:05 worker-6 received message msg_412 for ord_927
14:03:06 worker-6 mailer accepted delivery mail_892
```

The queue team confirmed this redelivery is expected behavior, including after a process dies. A fresh message identifier also isn't proof that the business event is new, because the scheduler can republish an outstanding reminder. The acceptance criterion is one reminder for that order and reminder event even when execution is interrupted and delivery happens again. Work within the existing worker storage and mailer interfaces rather than redesigning the scheduler.
